FIRSTEXTENSIONAGREEMENT This first extension agreement is entered into and made effective as of July 8, 2026, by and between 2922SHELL LLC with business address at 2922Shell Road,Brooklyn,New York11224, (the “Borrower"), and H AND S GROUP USA, LLC whose address is c/o Malvina Lin, P.C., 1203 Avenue J, Suite 4B, Brooklyn, New York 11230, ("Lender"). RECITALS A. Borrower is indebted to Lender pursuant to a Mortgage Promissory Note dated as of April 2, 2025 from Borrower in favor of Lender in the principal sum of Six Hundred Seventy Thousand ($670,000.00) (the "Note"). B. Borrower's obligations to Lender under the Note are secured by a first purchase money Mortgage, Assignment of Rents and Security Agreement in the principal sum of Six Hundred Seventy Thousand ($670,000.00) which is dated April 2, 2025 and which was recorded on April 17, 2025 in the Office of the City Register, in the County of Kings under CRFN 2025000104949, (the "Mortgage") which was further evidenced by a UCC- 1 financing statement filed on April 17, 2025 in the Office of the City Register, in the County of Kings under CRFN 2025000104950. C. Borrower desires to further extend and confirm the terms of such Note and Mortgage as referenced herein except to modify the terms of the Note and Mortgage to extend the maturity date. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the matters described above, and of the mutual benefits and obligations set forth in this agreement, the parties agree as follows: 1.Modification of preexisting agreement. Borrower and Lender now modify the above- described Note and Mortgage of April 2, 2025, according to the terms and conditions set agreement by this reference is made a part of this agreement, and all the terms and conditions of it, unless specifically modified in this agreement, are made a part of this agreement. All other terms and conditions set forth in the referenced Note and Mortgage
